activities.name: Run Promotion Sync App between DWH

sqlReaderQuery.value:
insert into fcst_pos_forecast_data (itemid, Channelid, Calendarid, [seasonality_type],[toolbox_forecast_type],[customer_code],[item_code],[week_date],[week_number],[lookback_window],
[reseason_and_repromo_forecast],[algo_created_date])
select im.itemManagerId itemid, ic.ItemAccountId Channelid, c.CalendarId Calendarid,
 [seasonality_type],[toolbox_forecast_type],[customer_code],[item_code],[week_date],'0',7,[reseason_and_repromo_forecast],getdate()
from [dbo].FACT_ALGO_BASELINE_FORECAST_EDW fs
inner join itemaccount ic WITH (NOLOCK) on ic.AccountName = fs.customer_code
inner join itemmanager im  WITH (NOLOCK) on im.SKU = fs.item_code
inner join calendar c WITH (NOLOCK) on DATEADD(DD,-6,c.WeekStartDate) = CAST(fs.week_date AS Date);
select 1;

[reseason_and_repromo_forecast],[algo_created_date])
select im.itemManagerId itemid, ic.ItemAccountId Channelid, c.CalendarId Calendarid,
 [seasonality_type],[toolbox_forecast_type],[customer_code],[item_code],[week_date],'0',7,[reseason_and_repromo_forecast],getdate()
from [dbo].FACT_ALGO_BASELINE_FORECAST_EDW fs
inner join itemaccount ic WITH (NOLOCK) on ic.AccountName = fs.customer_code

inner join calendar c WITH (NOLOCK) on DATEADD(DD,-6,c.WeekStartDate) = CAST(fs.week_date AS Date);
select 1;
